profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Full Stack & Digital Transformation Expert | Tech Leader & Innovator | Leading Cross-Functional Teams & System Modernization | Driving Scalable Solutions, System Reliability & Revenue Growth
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer with experience driving architecture decisions across clinical data platforms, search relevancy, and org-wide observability standards for engineering teams. With deep expertise in full-stack development, cloud-native architectures, and microservices, I specialize in designing, optimizing, and modernizing platforms that enhance operational efficiency and revenue generation. My passion lies in leading high-performing agile teams, ensuring seamless system reliability, and fostering a culture of clean, maintainable code.

Driving Innovation & Business Impact
I’ve tackled complex engineering challenges, led large-scale migrations, and spearheaded modernization initiatives that transformed legacy systems into scalable, cloud-native solutions. My work has directly supported $16B+ in annual revenue, optimized system integrations, and enhanced user experiences for 475K+ clients and 30K+ sellers.

Key Highlights & Accomplishments
✔ Architected & led the modernization of IBM’s quoting platform to SAP CPQ, ensuring seamless migration, business continuity, and $16B in revenue impact.

✔ Managed a portfolio of 25+ mission-critical applications, overseeing infrastructure upgrades, performance tuning, and technical debt reduction.

✔ Led a globally distributed team of 30 engineers, driving Agile development, enhancing cross-team collaboration, and streamlining workflows.

✔ Designed a robust backend architecture and integrating APIs that impact 4M Providers and 73% of Americans averaging 5,000 req/sec

Passion for Problem-Solving & Scalable Engineering
Beyond coding, I thrive in cross-functional leadership roles, ensuring that teams are aligned, processes are optimized, and technical roadblocks are eliminated. My approach combines deep technical expertise with a strategic mindset, enabling businesses to scale efficiently while maintaining system integrity and reliability.

Let’s connect and discuss how technology, architecture, and innovation can drive business success!

Core Competencies:
System Architecture | Cross-Functional Technical Leader | Operational Workflows | System Reliability | Technical Debt | Modernization | SAP CPQ | Microservices | Cloud Technologies | Integration | Data Processing | API Management | Testing Protocols | Technology Solutions | Dual-Version Support | SaaS Provisioning | User Experience | Automation | Process Improvement | Knowledge Transfer | Revenue-Driving | Problem Solving | Communication Skills

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead initiatives to build scalable, intelligent digital health platforms that make complex medical information more accessible and actionable for millions of users.

• Led a horizontal observability initiative across the engineering organization, standardizing monitoring and SLO of 99.9% uptime over a rolling 30 period for 27 services across 5 teams, and establishing a reusable instrumentation framework adopted as the org-wide standard. Triaged the full service inventory from GitHub org and Datadog APM data, delivered working reference implementations, and created a standardized instrumentation playbook reducing friction and improving discoverability.

• Delivered the ZocDoc cross-promotion integration after rapidly transitioning to the Healthgrades team; mastered a new (C#, .NET) GraphQL backend and shipped high-impact fixes on a system powering 4M+ provider profiles and supporting 73% of Healthgrades traffic.

• Led the Relevancy as a Service (RaaS) 2.0 infrastructure overhaul, driving architectural decisions, coordinating multiple teams, and delivering end-to-end features that reduced system complexity and enabled scalable clinical asset expansion.

• Modernized product search and ranking logic, improving product relevance scores from 0.07 → 6.18, increasing accuracy, and simplifying implementation paths for long-term maintainability.

• Host and lead Engineering@RVOH, a biweekly tech knowledge sharing series for company-wide engineering teams, curating content across: AI tooling debates, emerging technology deep-dives, and an Engineering Journeys interview series with varying levels of technical roles including the CTO; achieved an 8/10 average satisfaction score with 90% rating the series mid - high value within 4 months.

• Improved developer experience through upgraded documentation, standardized workflows, improved testing practices, and system debugging that accelerated team onboarding and productivity.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:

Back-End Development:
I design and implement robust RESTful APIs, web services, and databases, working closely with client-server architectures and networking protocols. Using object-oriented programming (OOP), multi-threading, and concurrency, I build efficient and scalable back-end systems. I write optimized SQL and NoSQL queries, develop stored procedures, and ensure database security in alignment with industry standards.
Technologies Used: Python, Java, Node.js, SQL, NoSQL, REST, Web Services.

Front-End Development:
Collaborating with designers, I turn wireframes into full-fledged, responsive, and performant user interfaces (UIs). I ensure that UIs are accessible, production-ready, and seamlessly integrated with back-end systems. In close collaboration with back-end developers, I ensure comprehensive unit testing, ensuring high-quality user-facing applications.
Technologies Used: JavaScript, React, Vue, HTML, CSS, JSON, API integration.

DevOps & CI/CD Engineering:
I contribute to the development and maintenance of a reliable CI/CD pipeline, ensuring seamless delivery from development to production. I automate deployment processes, monitor system performance, and optimize application availability, thereby enhancing productivity and system stability. Working with development teams, I implement defect prevention practices that maximize application uptime.
Technologies Used: Jenkins, OpenShift, IBM Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, Maven, Gradle

Collaboration & Agile Practices:
Working in an agile environment, I collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather stakeholder requirements, contribute to software architecture, and deliver high-quality software solutions. I actively participate in sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous improvement processes to elevate team efficiency and software quality.

projects.title: Automated DB Credential Rotation
projects.description:
The Automated DB Credential Rotation project focused on streamlining database credential management using AI-driven automation. By centralizing the process, we reduced manual intervention, minimized error, and ensured consistent, secure, and compliant credential updates across all systems.

As the team lead, I guided the development of this tool. I started by ensuring the team understood AI fundamentals and Enterprise Design Thinking principles, fostering a collaborative and responsible approach to AI usage. I earned a Knowledge Credential in Enterprise Design Thinking to ensure clear intent in our AI systems.

We defined the project’s intent, documented data points, and worked through the AI Essentials Framework. I led the architecture design, specifying inputs, outputs, and AI interactions with IBM's Granite model via API calls. Collaborating with the Platform team, we ensured the automated process adhered to security compliance standards and reduced manual effort.

The system identifies expiring credentials, generates secure secrets, and automatically rotates them. If errors occur, human intervention is requested. This solution improves security, reduces manual work, and ensures compliance with organizational policies.

Key Highlights:

AI Integration: Automated credential rotation using AI models.
Security & Compliance: Ensured adherence to security and compliance standards.
Collaboration: Facilitated cross-functional teamwork for project success.
Innovation: Streamlined credential management and improved security.
Leadership: Led the team through AI design, architecture, and compliance considerations.
This project significantly improved security, reduced manual processes, and ensured compliance, creating lasting value for the organization.

projects.title: Career Pioneer: Empowering Career Progression with Analytics & Fairness
projects.description:
Team Lead and Creator: Otis Smart

Career Pioneer is a platform that leverages analytics through a fairness-driven engine to enhance career progression. By combining financial transparency with the networking power of social media, Career Pioneer crowdsources data to help professionals match, compare, and receive personalized career guidance. The platform emphasizes equity, ensuring all users—regardless of background—have equal access to career insights and growth opportunities.

At the core of Career Pioneer is an impartial engine designed to provide unbiased career advice, promoting diversity and inclusion while helping professionals chart their paths forward. By offering a transparent and equitable approach, the platform empowers individuals to progress confidently in their careers.

I led the creation of a prototype for Career Pioneer, completing the task in under a week. This initiative was part of my involvement in the IBM Call for Code: Emb(race), which aimed to provide open-source solutions to combat racial injustice and inequality. The project used technology to promote fairness and create opportunities for underrepresented groups in the workforce.

Key Highlights:

Rapid Prototype: Delivered a functional prototype in under one week.
Social Impact: Focused on addressing racial inequality in the workforce.
Innovation: Integrated crowdsourced data and a fairness engine to provide actionable career insights.
Career Pioneer aims to create a more equitable workforce by offering the tools and guidance needed for professional growth and progression.
